name: Eldritch Horror

categories.label: Investigators won
categories.hint: Win immediately on solving 3 Mysteries; if the Ancient One awakened, win by solving the Final Mystery.

categories.label: Mysteries solved
categories.hint: Three solved Mysteries win the game.

categories.label: Ancient One awakened (Doom reached 0)
categories.hint: Doom reaching 0 awakens the Ancient One; investigators must then solve the Final Mystery.

winCondition: Investigators win by solving three Mysteries, or, if the Ancient One has awakened, by solving the Final Mystery. They lose if all investigators are eliminated, a card effect says so, or a Mythos card must be drawn from an empty deck; the awakened Ancient One adds its own loss conditions.

endCondition.description: 3 Mysteries solved (win), Final Mystery solved after awakening (win), or elimination / empty Mythos deck / card effect (loss).

notes: family: coop. No points. Ancient-One-specific details and expansions not modelled. Verified only against secondary rule summaries; the official rulebook PDF could not be retrieved.
